broadens the "hardship clause" to apply to exporting, taking or transporting in interstate commerce as well as to importation.
The proposed Act of 1973 clarifies the date from which the "hardship clause" shall extend by specifying that date as the time when the notice of proposed rule making first appears in the Federal Register. This provision prevents parties from engaging in last-minute contracts between the publication of the notice of Proposed Rule Making in the final publication of the list. The intervening period will be at least 30 days. See Appendix C for a comparison of present and proposed authority.
